title: Open-LLM-Leaderboard: From Multi-choice to Open-style Questions for LLMs Evaluation, Benchmark, and Arena
reasoning: The paper focuses on methodology for LLM evaluation by converting multiple-choice questions to open-style questions to avoid selection bias. While it contains a standard section on 'Limitations and Ethics Statement' as required by many conferences, the actual benchmark evaluation focuses on domains like STEM, medicine, and common knowledge rather than evaluating religion, faith, or ethics.
